name: day-75-sim-profile
statement: Inputs for profiling the pure-Python Day 73 launch simulator on the CPU with cProfile and time.perf_counter_ns. The workloads are the Day 73 vector add and grayscale kernels and the Day 74 naive matmul. No GPU runs, and no CUDA source is compiled.

rounds.change: Record each read inside DeviceBuffer.__getitem__ itself, with the same checks in the same order, instead of through _recorder_for, _record_read and _running.
Round through one precompiled struct.Struct('<f') instead of the module-level struct.pack and struct.unpack, which look up the format on every call.
Build the ThreadRef values of AccessRecorder.finish only for elements in a write or read-write conflict, instead of two Index3 values for every written element.
